info.name: Initiate Speech to Text Translate Bulk Job V1

items.docs: Create a new speech to text translate bulk job and receive a job UUID and storage folder details for processing multiple audio files with translation. Set `job_parameters.input_audio_codec` when uploads are raw PCM (`pcm_s16le`, `pcm_l16`, or `pcm_raw`); the API auto-detects other formats. PCM must be 16 kHz.

info.name: Upload Files for Speech to Text Translate Bulk Job V1

items.docs: Generate presigned upload URLs for audio files that will be processed in a speech to text translate bulk job

info.name: Start Speech to Text Translate Bulk Job V1

params.name: job_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the job

items.docs: Start processing a speech to text translate bulk job after all audio files have been uploaded

info.name: Get Speech to Text Translate Bulk Job V1 Status

params.name: job_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the job

items.docs:
Retrieve the current status and details of a speech to text translate bulk job, including progress and file-level information.

**Rate Limiting Best Practice:** To prevent rate limit errors and ensure optimal server performance, we recommend implementing a minimum 5-millisecond delay between consecutive status polling requests. This helps maintain system stability while still providing timely status updates.

info.name: Download Files for Speech to Text Translate Bulk Job V1

items.docs:
Generate presigned download URLs for the translated transcription output files of a completed speech to text translate bulk job.

**Required body fields:** `job_id` and `files` (array of output filenames such as `"0.json"`). Obtain filenames from the job status response after the job completes.

**Method:** POST only (GET returns 405).
